html:
LoMa (Nordström, Edstedt et al. 2026): sparse matching of two photos of one scene: DaD keypoints, DeDoDe-G descriptions (VGG19 plus DINOv2) and a light LightGlue-style transformer matcher; matches as keypoint index pairs (the form COLMAP takes). MIT code and weights; DINOv2 Apache-2.0.

Commercial use: yes.

Speed and memory not measured for: loma-b.

Details
  • Paper: LoMa: Local Feature Matching Revisited, ECCV 2026, 2026-04-06
  • Original code: https://github.com/davnords/loma at 415caedde23a
  • Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: LICENSE, LICENSE-DAD, LICENSE-DEDODE, LICENSE-DINOv2
  • Weights licence: MIT
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/davnords/loma/blob/415caedde23a9ed479172ed174fe4ff7b4514d4b/LICENSE ; https://github.com/Parskatt/dad/blob/41b9e86a1a3ae52128485cc1094aa4952ef489ba/LICENSE ; https://github.com/Parskatt/DeDoDe/blob/6d156183f4dc84cd704ae779eebc8350995c5b06/README.md#license
  • Training data: MegaDepth (Internet photo collections with SfM / MVS depth) (Matcher: MegaDepth (paper); DaD: MegaDepth-based distillation (DaD paper); DeDoDe-G descriptor: MegaDepth; DINOv2 (frozen): LVD-142M (Meta).)
  • Options: max_keypoints = 2048 (>= 1), long_side = 1024 (>= 16), size = 784 (>= 56)
  • Kernel libraries: none (not implemented yet)
  • Variants: loma-b
  • Outputs: keypoints1, keypoints2, pairs, scores
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): loma-b 3000x4000 (2.4 GiB peak allocated, 3.6 reserved)

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.011 vs the original. GPU, portable bfloat16 and kernels float16 (the defaults): mean |diff| <= 0.002 and p99 <= 0.001 (absolute error of the output keypoints1).

Limitations

  • Sparse output: no dense warp. result.matches() gives the matched points for estimate_pose; pairs are the index pairs pycolmap / COLMAP databases take.
  • One image pair per call internally (batches run pair by pair); the match counts differ per pair.
  • No exportable module: the match counts are data-dependent (torch.compile runs with graph breaks; ONNX / TensorRT export fails).
  • Two resizes per image as upstream: the detector sees a long side of long_side (aspect kept), the descriptor a size x size square whatever the aspect ratio.
  • Upright only: the released weights are not trained for in-plane rotations.
